notes: Table 0 is a pricing/offer export: one row per SKU, 12 rows, no title row, header on row 0.
SKU values are zero-padded (00470001) but the profiler typed the column int; extract as text to keep the leading zeros and satisfy item_code as string.

Tax rate is an explicit source value of 5% in all rows; convert to the fraction 0.05 for /money/tax_fraction without inferring any other rate.
'Tax included' = No means the net prices are tax-exclusive; the mapping uses the net price as supplied, with no vat_adjust, per the operator requirement.
Date column header explicitly declares DD/MM/YYYY, so 03/04/2026 resolves to 2026-04-03 (no DMY/MDY ambiguity question needed).
'Sales unit' (PCS) and 'Price list' (standard) have no corresponding target pointer in the commercial-offer contract and are retained as source context only.
